title: Crestline Fleet Account Program Ladder by Roster Size and Entity
content:
The Crestline Fleet Account is offered as six programs. Which program a business or public agency holds is set by the size of the roster of vehicles it enrolls and by its entity type, and each program states the fewest and the most vehicles it is for.

## Program schedule

| Program | Fewest vehicles | Most vehicles | Years in business at entry | Entity type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 1 | 4 | 1 | private business |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 5 | 24 | 1 | private business |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 25 | 99 | 2 | private business |
| Crestline Fleet National | 100 | 499 | 2 | private business |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 500 | no maximum | 3 | private business |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 1 | no maximum | 0 | government or public agency |

The fewest-vehicles figure is an integer; the most-vehicles figure is an integer or "no maximum".

## How roster size is read and when roster changes count

| Program | Roster size compared with the program limits as | An added or removed vehicle takes effect | Roster outside the program's range |
|---|---|---|---|
| All six programs | the count of enrolled vehicles | on the same day, the date given | triggers a program change at the next credit review rather than immediately |

Every program carries the same three settings in this table: the roster size is the count of vehicles enrolled on the account; a vehicle added or removed takes effect on the same day, that is on the date given for the change; and a roster that has moved outside the program's range leads to a program change at the next scheduled credit review, not at the moment the roster moves.

## Points of reference

- A roster of 4 enrolled vehicles sits inside the Crestline Fleet Starter range (1 to 4); a fifth enrolled vehicle takes it to 5, the first figure of the Crestline Fleet Business range, and under the review setting above the program itself is looked at at the next credit review.
- Crestline Fleet Enterprise and Crestline Fleet Public Sector have no maximum roster size.
- Crestline Fleet Public Sector is the one program whose entity type is a government or public agency; the other five are for private businesses.
